analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions showed RSI neutral range consolidation and ADX 11.7 trendless continuation. Today's RSI at 45.2 declined but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram worsened from 72.6179 to -101.4388, signaling a bearish turn. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at $62,920.45 above the 20-day low at $62,226.58. However, MACD deterioration and trendless ADX lack conviction for a trend reversal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
